summary: Iteration 123: a narrow final check of the SOURCE_SLOT lock-guard fix, one Studio render pass, and the new operational driver. Everything ran on the isolated DB tejas_isolated_iter105_test with MOCKED auth and MOCKED storage. There were no live or preview production calls, no real storage or LLM calls, and no customer-DB writes. BACKEND: test_iter123_jee_lock_guard_isolated.py passed 43/43 on two runs with no flakes, no 'never awaited' warnings and no 'Task exception was never retrieved' warnings. That is the full iteration-122 suite of 39 plus 4 new tests, which patch via proxies of the real asyncio module. (1) Real asyncio.to_thread with a shut-down default executor raises before verify_pdf runs: 3 repeated steps each return 500 (not 429), SOURCE_SLOT is released, the lease is released, verified_files=0, there are 0 storage calls and 0 target inserts. (2) to_thread raising inside guarded_pdf_check gives the same result: the slot is released. (3) create_task raising: the coroutine is closed (no RuntimeWarning after gc), the slot is released and the lease is released. (4) The next normal step returns 200, verified_files=1 with exactly 1 GET, and J.asyncio is restored. The timeout test with a single shielded thread (503, then repeated 429 with Retry-After 30, max 1 active GET, the orphan result not counted) still passes. Mutation check: with the except-branch work.close()/release removed, the create_task test and the follow-up test fail, so the new tests discriminate. DRIVER: test_iter123_driver_isolated.py passed 13/13 using a fake requests.Session. A socket guard allowed only 127.0.0.1:8768, login was faked with FAKE env creds, and crop bytes were faked PNGs. All other calls went to the real endpoints on the isolated bridge. Results: an invalid target (http, userinfo, a path, a query, a fragment, no scheme) gives a ValueError before any call. A probe that is not 401 stops with no login and no logout. A 401 on login gives a clean error with no logout. A mid-run 409 makes the driver log out (operational_session_closed=true) and exit 1. A full run reached complete_verified: 81 verified, 162 records, 78 chapters. The catalogue showed 29/26/23 and the samples showed 90/120/70, with the real preview payload equal to the bundle questions. The driver logged out last, sent Origin on every call, the report has mode 0600, and the report and stdout contain neither the fake nor the real ENV credentials (nor the word 'password'). A rerun after completion is a no-op with no step POSTs. FRONTEND: the Studio JeeTransferPanel was routed to the isolated bridge at 1920x800 and 390x844. Document, panel and child overflow were all 0, there were 0 step calls on mount, and Start then Pause gave 1/81 and 'Resume verified import'. Cleanup done: bridge killed, isolated DB dropped, /tmp files removed. A read-only preview DB probe shows it unchanged: 222 sets, 6 books, 134 files, no receipt, 0 docs without an id.

minor.issue: Any single non-200 step (e.g. a 503 timeout or a 429 'still finishing') aborts the run; the driver does not honour Retry-After. Resuming is safe, but the operator must re-run manually.
The crop-asset GET uses the default allow_redirects=True, unlike the other calls (allow_redirects=False). This is harmless (requests scopes cookies to the domain) but inconsistent.

critical_code_review_comments: The lock guard is correct. guarded_pdf_check releases the slot in a finally block once the task is running. create_task failure closes the coroutine and releases the slot. The only theoretical remaining leak is the inner task being cancelled before its first step, which only happens at loop shutdown and is acceptable.
Driver: if logout fails, the server-side session stays valid until expiry. It is only reported as operational_session_closed=false, which is acceptable.
Driver: the report is written and then chmod-ed to 0600 (a brief umask window). It contains no secrets, so this is minor.
seed_data_creation: Isolated DB only (dropped). No customer data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lock-guard regression: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest test_iter123_jee_lock_guard_isolated.py -p no:asyncio -n0. Driver test: start python iso_bridge_iter122.py & (freshly seeded, port 8768), then python -m pytest test_iter123_driver_isolated.py -p no:asyncio -n0. The full-run test needs a non-complete receipt, so it is order-dependent; restart the bridge for a fresh DB. Afterwards kill the bridge, drop tejas_isolated_iter105_test and run iter121_realdb_readonly_probe.py. The production import has NOT been run.
